testsuite.name: gspa.ontology.GoReasonerConcurrencySpec

testcase.name: concurrent clients trigger one extraction and all see the full entailed has_part relation
the shared result cannot be mutated by a client
the same ontology version is served from memory without more ELK queries
replacing the ontology object re-initializes the reasoner and never attributes old entailments to the new ontology
reloading different axioms into the same GoOntology is detected
in-place axiom addition with a populated disk cache is detected and the stale file is neither read nor overwritten
replacing one axiom with another of the same count yields the different entailed relation
hierarchy indexes and caches follow in-place edits
reloading a file clears the previous ontology's indexes and marks the digest reliable again
initializing twice disposes the previous reasoner, and a failed initialization keeps the working one
clients stay consistent while another thread re-initializes
